html:
Broërec was an early medieval Breton realm around Vannes in southern Brittany, from about 490 to about 635. It is on the map for 600.

Its people were Christian Britons who had crossed from Britain, many fleeing the Anglo-Saxons, and who mixed with the older Gaulish people of Armorica. The name means "land of Waroch", after a ruler who in the late 500s fought the Frankish kings for control of the lands around Vannes and raided toward Rennes and Nantes. Its neighbours across the sea included Dumnonia. The area remained a heartland of the Breton language.
sum: Broërec was an early medieval Breton realm around Vannes in southern Brittany, from about 490 to about 635. It is on the map for 600.
